title: Sigil and Wolf Anew
premise: Isandro Okonkwo, the crown's food-taster, has spent years dosing themselves with poisons and learning every smuggler's path through the Thornfell mountains — but their true secret is the gift of sigil-craft they hide beneath a servant's plainness. When the queen declares a purge of all gifted people, Isandro's oldest friend is seized and her soul sold to the court beneath the mountain as payment for the crown's debts. Refusing to let law masquerade as justice, Isandro flees into Thornfell with a disgraced wolf-shifter named Bren and a smuggler who knows too much. To save their friend they must steal back her soul before the long winter seals the mountain court for a generation — and in doing so, Isandro must decide whether loyalty means keeping their identity buried or claiming the gift that could doom them all. The story ends with the soul reclaimed at terrible cost: the mountain court shattered, the purge turned back on the queen by evidence Isandro carries out, and Isandro standing openly gifted as winter falls.
about_author: J. M. Pemberton is the pen name of a former line cook from the Pacific Northwest who swears the kitchen taught them everything they know about poison, politics, and loyalty. They write fantasy about people whose useful talents are also their most dangerous secrets.

chapters.title: The Taster's Tongue
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. A banquet scene establishes Isandro's double life: tasting the queen's food while secretly neutralizing a poisoned dish with a hidden sigil. Their friend Sefa, a kitchen maid, nearly catches them. Emotional beat: the exhausting vigilance of a hidden self, and the warmth that makes hiding worthwhile.

chapters.title: Edicts in Ash
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The queen proclaims the Purge of Gifts; criers name penalties and rewards for informants. Isandro burns their sigil-tools but cannot burn the gift itself. Sefa quietly reveals she knew all along. Emotional beat: fear curdling into resolve as friendship outweighs survival.

chapters.title: What the Wolf Dragged In
chapters.summary: POV Bren. Bren, a wolf-shifter caught in the first sweep, escapes the city through the kitchens where Isandro hides him. Their bargain forms: he knows the mountain court's old doors; she knows the smuggler roads. Emotional beat: two hunted people choosing trust over suspicion.

chapters.title: Sefa Taken
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Returning for Sefa, Isandro finds her seized — not for the gift, but sold by a magistrate to the court beneath the mountain against the crown's debts. Her soul will be collateral until spring. Emotional beat: guilt and fury; justice and law split cleanly apart.

chapters.title: The Smuggler's Ledger
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Isandro blackmails old contact Rook Vane, a smuggler who once bought safe passage with Isandro's silence about his routes. Rook joins for his own reasons: the mountain court holds his brother's soul too. Emotional beat: uneasy alliance built on mutual leverage.

chapters.title: Into Thornfell
chapters.summary: POV Bren. The three enter the mountains as the first snows fall. Bren leads them off the maps through wolf-paths only shifters can smell. A near-discovery by a purge patrol forces Isandro to use a sigil openly for the first time. Emotional beat: exhilaration and terror of being seen.

chapters.title: Salt and Snowbound
chapters.summary: POV Rook. Storm-bound in a smuggler cache, Rook tells how the mountain court buys souls as currency and why he abandoned his brother. Isandro admits the taster's immunity was built on poisons meant for others. Emotional beat: confessions that turn strangers into something like family.

chapters.title: The Toll-Keeper's Bridge
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. A river spirit demands a toll of true names. Bren gives his, binding himself to the river; Isandro refuses and bargains instead with a riddle won by a taster's trained palate. Emotional beat: identity as currency — what each will pay and what they'll protect.

chapters.title: Wolves of the High Pass
chapters.summary: POV Bren. Bren's old pack finds them; he is branded traitor for leaving during the last purge. He must fight the pack's second to pass. Isandro breaks pack-law by intervening. Emotional beat: loyalty tested against belonging; Bren chooses the found pack.

chapters.title: Doors Beneath the Root
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. They find the sealed gate to the mountain court, guarded by sigils older than the crown. Isandro reads them — and realizes the court's magic shares roots with their own gift. Emotional beat: awe and dread; the gift is heritage, not curse.

chapters.title: The Court of Debts
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Disguised as a debt-broker's clerk, Isandro enters the court and sees Sefa's soul kept in a lantern-glass, dimming as winter deepens. The court's regent offers a trade: a stronger soul for hers. Emotional beat: horror at what souls cost, temptation whispering.

chapters.title: A Taste of Regent
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Invited to feast with the regent, Isandro tastes every dish — and detects poison meant for the regent by a rival faction within the court. Saving the regent buys an audience. Emotional beat: the taster's skill becomes leverage in a deadlier court than the crown's.

chapters.title: Rook's Reckoning
chapters.summary: POV Rook. Rook locates his brother's soul-lantern but hesitates — freeing it will alert the wardens. He frees it anyway, triggering alarms. Emotional beat: cowardice finally broken; love outrunning calculation.

chapters.title: Hunted Through Halls
chapters.summary: POV Bren. Wardens hunt the intruders through shifting corridors. Bren fights a rearguard action in wolf-form and is gravely wounded buying Isandro time to reach the vault. Emotional beat: sacrifice without hesitation; the pack-of-three holds.

chapters.title: The Lantern Vault
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Before Sefa's lantern, Isandro discovers the truth: the queen has been selling gifted souls to the court for decades — the Purge is harvest, not justice. Evidence sits in the court's own ledgers. Emotional beat: rage crystallizing into purpose.

chapters.title: Bargain with Winter
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The regent corners them: leave Sefa and go free, or stay past first frost when the gates seal for a generation. Isandro counters — the regent owes a taster's life-debt from the poisoned feast. Emotional beat: wit against power; the debt called due.

chapters.title: What the Sigil Costs
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Unsealing Sefa's lantern requires a sigil of unbinding drawn in the maker's own blood and name — full exposure of the gift. Isandro claims their identity aloud for the first time and pays it. Emotional beat: the climax of the identity theme; freedom through self-acceptance.

chapters.title: The Mountain Wakes
chapters.summary: POV Bren. The unbinding shatters the court's foundation; the regent, honoring the debt, opens the gates as the mountain begins to close. Carrying wounded Bren and two freed souls, they race the sealing dark. Emotional beat: desperate flight, held together by chosen loyalty.

chapters.title: First Frost
chapters.summary: POV Rook. They emerge as the gates seal behind them, the long winter falling on Thornfell. Rook buries his brother's empty lantern and weeps. Sefa wakes, her soul scarred but whole. Emotional beat: grief and relief entwined; survival's quiet aftermath.

chapters.title: Evidence in Ink
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Descending to the lowlands, Isandro copies the court's ledgers proving the queen's soul-trade and sends them to every crier, garrison, and rival house. The Purge collapses under its own exposed corruption. Emotional beat: justice delivered outside the law, deliberately.

chapters.title: Sigil and Wolf
chapters.summary: POV Isandro and Bren. The queen's guard comes for Isandro one last time; Bren stands at their side openly, and the arriving soldiers — many gifted themselves, now unafraid — refuse the order. Emotional beat: the hidden life ends; loyalty and truth finally aligned.

chapters.title: A Table Set for Four
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Epilogue: spring thaw. Isandro cooks a meal with no poison in any dish, served to Sefa, Bren, and Rook in a small house above the valley. Isandro signs a new guild charter for gifted healers and tasters. Emotional beat: peace earned, identity home, loyalty rewarded.
